subject: CareLogic: ID & Access evidence + SOC 2 timeline — next steps
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@carelogic.com>, Audrey Chen <audrey.chen@carelogic.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-04-11T15:22:00-07:00
Subject: Recap — ID & Access / SOC 2 items and next steps

Thanks both — great conversation earlier. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we have a single thread to track this: 

1) SOC 2 status
- Redwood is currently in the final stages of a Type II audit (controls testing completed Q1). Expected delivery of the report and auditor letter: 2028-06-15 (we will share redacted report once available).

2) GDPR / HIPAA coverage
- We support HIPAA-covered workloads via our Private offering (VPC + BAAs). We maintain GDPR data subject handling processes; we can share our privacy notice + DPA template.

3) Identity & Access (what CareLogic requested)
- SSO: SAML 2.0 supported (IdP-initiated and SP-initiated). We can provide metadata and sample ACS/Entity IDs.
- SCIM: SCIM v2 provisioning supported — SCIM endpoints require a token and support bulk sync + deltas.
- RBAC / admin controls: configurable org roles, audit logs for admin actions, and enterprise RBAC mappings.

Requested immediate artifacts (we can deliver these this week):
- Redwood SAML metadata (metadata XML)
- A short SAML + SCIM summary doc for your InfoSec team (attached)
- A draft RBAC matrix and explanation of admin roles

Next steps / owners:
- Marissa (me) will send the SAML metadata and summary doc (today) — ATTACHED: redwood-saml-scim-summary.pdf
- Ben will coordinate delivery of RBAC snapshot and admin role definitions (by 2028-04-13)
- Priyom (security) will follow up with the formal evidence checklist and be the primary contact for your questionnaire (cc'd once we kick off)

Please confirm the best contact on your side for receiving SAML metadata and whether you have a preferred test SP/IdP for a sandbox run. Also attaching the post-call notes for reference.

Attachments: redwood-postcall-notes-20280411.pdf, redwood-saml-scim-summary.pdf

Thanks — Marissa

--
Marissa Cole
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0182
redwood.com
From: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@carelogic.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Audrey Chen <audrey.chen@carelogic.com>
Date: 2028-04-12T09:11:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Recap — ID & Access / SOC 2 items and next steps

Thanks Marissa — appreciate the clear recap. A couple quick asks from my side: 

- Can you confirm the expected SOC 2 Type II delivery date in writing (we need to capture on our security intake)? The Q2 date you mentioned is fine; we just need an ETA and whether the report will be redacted.
- We'll need your SAML metadata and the SCIM provisioning spec to hand to our IAM team. A short implementation guide is ideal (ACS/Entity IDs, required attributes, provisioning attributes).
- I'm attaching our vendor security questionnaire (InfoSec's standard). Can you have someone on your security team review and return it? If it's easier, Priyom can take point.

For contact: I'm primary for procurement/security coordination; Audrey will be our technical lead for SSO work.

Thanks — Liam

Attachments: carelogic-security-questionnaire.xlsx

Hi Liam / Audrey —

Thanks — confirming in-line:
- SOC 2: ETA 2028-06-15 for the final Type II report; we'll provide a redacted copy suitable for vendor review. I'll also include a short cover note explaining scope (authentication, authorization, change management, incident response).
- SAML/SCIM: attached is a short implementation guide + the SAML metadata URL. It includes required NameID formats and the minimal attribute set we expect. Liam — if your team prefers, we can schedule a short technical sync (30 minutes) with Audrey and our infra/security engineer to walk through SAML ACS testing and SCIM mapping. Proposed windows: 2028-04-14 09:00-11:00 PDT or 2028-04-14 13:00-15:00 PDT. Let me know which works.

Marissa

From: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
To: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@carelogic.com>, Audrey Chen <audrey.chen@carelogic.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-04-13T09:04:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Recap — ID & Access / SOC 2 items and next steps

Hi Liam / Audrey — looping in from Redwood security. Thanks for the questionnaire — I've started a pass and attached a checklist so we can track item-by-item. A few specific asks to help accelerate evidence delivery: 

1) SAML
- Please share a test SP metadata or a test IdP if you want Redwood to push an SP-initiated test. Otherwise we'll provide a sandbox SP and you can initiate from your IdP.
- Request: sample IdP certificate (public key) and a test account we can use for validation.

2) SCIM
- Please confirm whether you need group -> application mapping (i.e., group-based entitlements) and an initial user import or just provisioning for active hires.
- We'll provide SCIM docs (endpoints, headers, example payloads) once we have a signed mutual NDA or an approved secure share.

3) RBAC / Admin controls
- We can provide a CSV export of admin role definitions, current admin user list (redacted), and an audit-log extract for admin actions scoped to the last 90 days. Let us know the required time window.

4) SOC 2 artifacts
- We'll share a redacted report on 2028-06-15 as discussed; in the meantime I can provide our control matrix and a description of controls for authn/authz/change management.

I've attached: iam-evidence-checklist.csv (simple tracker) and a saml-metadata-template.xml (for your IAM team if they want to validate fields). We'll start working through your attached carelogic-security-questionnaire.xlsx and return the completed version by 2028-04-18. If there are high-priority sections, flag them and we'll prioritize.

Proposed next step: 30-minute tech call to validate SAML ACS and SCIM attribute mapping. Marissa — please pick one of the times above and I'll make sure our infra engineer is present.

Attachments: iam-evidence-checklist.csv, saml-metadata-template.xml

Best —
Priyom Das
Security Operations, Redwood Inference
priyom.das@redwood.com
